description: For call center, contact center, phone or chat staffing questions with a service level target, such as 80% answered within 20 seconds. Works out agents needed on a live queue to answer a target share of contacts within a target time, using Erlang C. Give contacts per hour for the interval being staffed (usually the busiest hour) and handle time in seconds. Returns agents needed, the service level at that number and at one fewer, chance of waiting, occupancy, and people to schedule after shrinkage. Use required_fte for case or ticket work with no answer-time target.

answer_within_seconds.description: Target answer time in seconds. Default 20.

contacts_per_hour.description: Contacts arriving per hour in the interval being staffed.

handle_time_seconds.description: Average handle time in seconds: talk plus after-contact work.

service_level.description: Share of contacts to answer within the target time. Default 0.8.

shrinkage.description: Share of paid time agents are off the queue. Converts agents to people scheduled. Default 0.3.

name: erlang_staffing
title: Queue staffing (Erlang C)
